# `aitbc monitor history`

Show historical monitoring data for a period.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc monitor history [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--period` | text | `7d` | no | Analysis period (1d, 7d, 30d) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc monitor history
```
